description: The 'dss_agenttools_cached' dataset provides a comprehensive overview of agent tools used within Dataiku DSS projects. Each entry in the dataset represents a unique agent tool, identified by a project key and an agent tool ID. The dataset includes detailed metadata such as the tool's name, type, and a description tailored for large language models (LLMs). Additionally, it records the user who created and last modified the tool, along with timestamps of these actions. The dataset also contains JSON-formatted parameters for each tool, an identifier for the associated LLM, and any relevant tags. A URL is provided for direct access to each tool. This dataset is particularly useful for managing and auditing agent tools within Dataiku DSS, facilitating easy access to tool configurations and their usage history. It can be leveraged for optimizing tool deployment, ensuring compliance with project standards, and enhancing collaboration among team members by providing clear documentation and traceability of tool modifications.
shortDesc: Dataset of Dataiku DSS agent tools with metadata and descriptions.
